z.$description: Stacking order. Use these instead of raw z-index values; each layer sits above the ones before it.

base.$description: Default stacking: the normal page flow.

raised.$description: Lifts an element above its siblings, such as the focused item in a button group.

dropdown.$description: Menus and listboxes anchored to a control.

sticky.$description: Sticky headers and toolbars that scroll with the page until they pin.

fixed.$description: Bars fixed to the viewport: banners and bottom navigation.

overlay.$description: Backdrops that dim the page behind a drawer or dialog.

popover.$description: Popovers, which can open from inside a dialog.

toast.$description: Toast notifications, above dialogs so they are never hidden.

tooltip.$description: Tooltips, which can describe anything below them.

skip-link.$description: The skip link, which must be visible above everything when focused.
